evals.prompt: Implement the domain model and application service for registering a new user in our hexagonal architecture system.
evals.expected_output: Domain entity with __slots__, a protocol-based repository port in application/ports, and a UserService receiving the repository via dependency injection.
assertions: The User domain model defines __slots__ or uses @dataclass(slots=True)
The repository port is defined in the application layer using typing.Protocol
The UserService receives the repository port via constructor dependency injection
Domain models and logic contain zero infrastructure or framework imports
Specific domain exceptions are defined and raised on validation errors

evals.prompt: Implement an order fulfillment service with a payment gateway adapter in hexagonal architecture.
evals.expected_output: An Order domain entity, a PaymentGatewayPort protocol, an OrderFulfillmentService, and an external StripePaymentAdapter in infrastructure.
assertions: The PaymentGatewayPort is defined as a typing.Protocol in application/ports
The domain entity contains pure business logic and transition invariants
The service depends only on ports, not on concrete infrastructure adapters
